sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# SPACE to red diamond
result = action(['SPACE'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation

for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'W':
        b = n['boundary']
        print(f"Player at ({b[0][0]}, {b[0][1]})")

# Find red diamond center
red_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'r' and n['pixels'] > 10]
if red_nodes:
    all_red = []
    for n in red_nodes:
        for p in n['boundary']:
            all_red.append(p)
    rows = [p[0] for p in all_red]
    cols = [p[1] for p in all_red]
    print(f"Red diamond: center~({(min(rows)+max(rows))//2}, {(min(cols)+max(cols))//2}), span={max(rows)-min(rows)}x{max(cols)-min(cols)}")

# Find orange X center
orange_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'O']
if orange_nodes:
    all_orange = []
    for n in orange_nodes:
        for p in n['boundary']:
            all_orange.append(p)
    rows = [p[0] for p in all_orange]
    cols = [p[1] for p in all_orange]
    print(f"Orange X: center~({(min(rows)+max(rows))//2}, {(min(cols)+max(cols))//2})")

# Find blue cross center
blue_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] > 10]
if blue_nodes:
    all_blue = []
    for n in blue_nodes:
        for p in n['boundary']:
            all_blue.append(p)
    rows = [p[0] for p in all_blue]
    cols = [p[1] for p in all_blue]
    print(f"Blue cross: center~({(min(rows)+max(rows))//2}, {(min(cols)+max(cols))//2})")

containers = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'c' and n['pixels'] == 8]
print(f"Containers: {len(containers)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
